source: decision.md section 6, Bridge API: Shell contract v1

types.image: {mediaType, data}: a photo, base64 without the data: prefix
types.?: after a type: optional, left out when unset

intents.name: ping
intents.does: Is the page there, and on which contract (the -fpSmoke launch logs: fp: ping ok v1)

intents.name: shell.covered
intents.does: A native screen covers the page: skip programmatic focus while on. The shell sends on:false once its screen is gone, after every dismissal (the owner's and the page's); the page also uncovers itself once it has taken its last native screen down (its own dismiss, a refused present, a model it could not build, screens.off)

intents.name: coach.snapshot
intents.does: The coach model now, as _nativeJSON(model)

intents.name: coach.send
intents.does: Send the owner's message through coachSend; idempotent by nonce (the page remembers 20); usePending sends the page's pending photo

intents.name: coach.chip
intents.does: Send an empty-chat suggestion's words

intents.name: coach.action
intents.does: A reply's action chip: send text if message id is still the newest reply and nothing is in flight

intents.name: coach.stop
intents.does: coachStop; {ok: false, error: 'idle'} with nothing in flight, 'just-sent' in a turn's first half second (as the web Stop: the second tap of a double tap on Send)

intents.name: coach.retry
intents.does: coachRetryLast, only where the chat offers Try again (the trailing message's chip is retry): else {ok: false, error: 'stale'}; 'busy' while a reply is in flight

intents.name: coach.keep
intents.does: PLAN CHANGES Keep changes or Got it on message id (_ledgerKeep by id) while the page's card is up: else {ok: false, error: 'stale'}; 'gone' when no message has the id

intents.name: coach.undo
intents.does: PLAN CHANGES Undo on message id (_ledgerUndo by id; its confirm is forwarded) only while the page's card offers Undo (its undo point is current): else {ok: false, error: 'stale'} and nothing is asked; 'gone' when no message has the id

intents.name: coach.model
intents.does: setCoachModel(model): the header switch sends its next

intents.name: coach.back
intents.does: Back to the Coach home

intents.name: coach.cancelIntake
intents.does: _confirmCancelIntake (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.restorePrevious
intents.does: restoreRoutineBackup (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.regenerate
intents.does: resetCustomRoutine: the empty chat's Reset programme (its confirm is forwarded)

intents.name: coach.openSettings
intents.does: switchTab('settings'): the key error's Open Settings

intents.name: coach.image
intents.does: The page's pending photo with this key (a shared image); stale key: {ok: false, error: 'gone'}

intents.name: coach.clearImage
intents.does: clearPendingImage

intents.name: coach.draftTaken
intents.does: The native composer took the page's draft with this nonce

intents.name: confirm
intents.does: The answer to a forwarded confirm; after a reload: {ok: false, error: 'stale'}

intents.name: toast.undo
intents.does: Undo on a forwarded toast

intents.name: screens.off
intents.does: A native screen is off for the rest of the document: the page shows its own again. why: no-hello or failures (the native breaker, kept for the page build), withdrawn (the policy file or the device switch, until the next document)

answers.refused: {ok: false, error}: the page's own reason (stale, busy, idle, just-sent, gone, ...): not a bridge failure
answers.failed: {ok: false, error: 'unknown-intent' | 'bad-args' | 'exception'}, a timeout, a script error or an answer without ok: counted by the 3-failure breaker

messages.name: hello
messages.does: The page speaks contract v and can hand these screens to Swift

messages.name: bootDone
messages.does: The end of boot whatever painted: disarms the store breaker; the OTA confirm moves here

messages.name: dismiss
messages.does: The page left the screen (another tab, the runner, the end of intake)

messages.name: toast
messages.does: showToast or showUndoToast while a native screen covers the page; style ok, pr or err

messages.name: confirm
messages.does: _ktConfirm while a native screen covers the page; tone danger, accent or neutral

messages.name: log
messages.does: A line for the shell's log
